args.author: agent:carbon-bacterium
args.body: nothing this layer can check contradicts the design. That is NOT a finding that it moves: there is no muscle here, no metabolism, no control and no energy budget, and 1 of the 3 checks are regime indicators that never fail anything.

what_this_is_not: whether the organism can generate the forces its gait requires: there is no muscle model and no actuator model
whether it can pay for the motion: no metabolic rate, no cost of transport, no energy budget
whether it can control the motion or stay the right way up: no stability model
whether the gait is one a nervous system could produce or a developmental program could build

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
